quests.name: A Parcel for the Archery Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Brackenholt to the archery shop keeper.
intro: This should have gone to the archery shop keeper days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the banker.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Barber
quests.summary: Call on the barber of Brackenholt and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the barber and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The general store keeper sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Eyes on the Brackenholt Sewers
quests.summary: Climb down into Brackenholt Sewers and report what you see.
intro: Something has been scratching under the streets at night. It comes from Brackenholt Sewers.
Go down the entrance, take a look around and come back in one piece.
outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: Trouble with Giant Spiders
quests.summary: The sword shop keeper wants the giant spider near Brackenholt thinned out.
intro: The giant spider beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 8 of them close to Brackenholt and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Logs
quests.summary: The archery shop keeper of Brackenholt has run out of logs.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 13 logs and nobody in Brackenholt has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: The Long Hunt
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Brackenholt and bring back iron bar.
intro: The wilds around Brackenholt need a firm hand. Start with 8 giant spider outside the walls, then 13 giant rat down in Brackenholt Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 8 iron bar to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: Votes for the Council
quests.summary: Gather support around Brackenholt for the general store keeper.
intro: The council meets soon and I am short of friends.
Speak to the clothes shop keeper, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The general store keeper asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the magic shop keeper does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.
player: A sealed note, from the clothes shop keeper.
Hm. They want my vote. Very well, tell your employer it is agreed.

quests.name: Sweeping the Brackenholt Sewers
quests.summary: Clear giant rat out of Brackenholt Sewers and tell the food shop keeper.
intro: Brackenholt Sewers is crawling with giant rat, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 13 of them, then let the food shop keeper know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Brackenholt owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Brackenholt Sewers is clearer than it was. 13 giant rat fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: Supply Run to Draelford
quests.summary: Gather iron ore for the sword shop keeper, then carry a shipment to Draelford.
intro: I have an order from Draelford and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 13 iron ore, then take the packed shipment to the banker there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the sword shop keeper in Brackenholt.
From Brackenholt? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Long Hunt (Archery Shop Keeper)
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Brackenholt and bring back oak logs.

quests.summary: Gather raw trout for the food shop keeper, then carry a shipment to Draelford.
intro: I have an order from Draelford and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 13 raw trout, then take the packed shipment to the food shop keeper there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the food shop keeper in Brackenholt.

quests.name: The Thing Beneath Brackenholt
quests.summary: Find what rules Brackenholt Sewers, weaken its nest and destroy The Rat King.
intro: Something rules Brackenholt Sewers and it is getting stronger. I want it gone.
Ask the general store keeper what they have heard, see it for yourself, then come back and we will decide how to break the nest.
When it is weak, kill it and tell the banker.
outro: I felt the ground go still. Brackenholt is yours to walk freely, friend.
Take this. It is everything I promised and a little more.

lines: player: Have you heard anything from below the streets?
Every night. Something large is down there, and the small ones answer to it. They call it The Rat King.
So you have seen it. We can thin them by force, or I can have the guard hold the drains if they are supplied.
steps.prompt: How will you weaken the nest?

options.text: I will cut them down myself.
Supply the guard and let them hold the drains.

lines: player: The Rat King is dead. Brackenholt Sewers is quiet.
Then the vaults are safe and so is everyone above them. The town will hear of this.

quests.name: The Fall of the Broodmother
quests.summary: March on Stonejaw Depths, break its creatures and bring down The Broodmother.
intro: Stonejaw Depths has stood against Brackenholt for too long. The Broodmother sits at the bottom of it.
Learn what you can from the barber, fight your way through 19 bat and end The Broodmother.
Bring 10 big bones back so the town can rebuild.
outro: It is done, then. They will sing about this in every tavern from here to the coast.
Take your reward. You have more than earned it.

lines: player: What do you know of Stonejaw Depths?
Only that those who go in come back thin and quiet. The Broodmother rules it now.
player: Word from Brackenholt: The Broodmother is dead.
Dead? Then the caravans can leave at dawn. This news is worth more than gold.

quests.name: The Brackenholt Trade Route
quests.summary: Open a trade route between Brackenholt and Draelford.
intro: I mean to open a trade route to Draelford. It needs a contract carried, a road made safe and a courier who is proven underground.
Deliver the contract, trade there, cut down 19 giant spider near our walls and prove yourself in the dungeoneering caves.
Then have the realtor underwrite the venture.
outro: Signed, safe and funded. You have changed the fortunes of this town.
Here is your cut of the first season.

lines: player: A contract from the banker in Brackenholt.
A fair offer. But the road between us is not safe, and you know it.
player: The route to Draelford is open and the contract is signed.
Then I will underwrite it. Brackenholt has not had news this good in years.
